channel.title: The San Francisco Standard - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Francisco Standard (sfstandard.com)

item.title: Salvation Army asks $58M for Mission land. Market-rate housing developers are lining up
item.description: The international charity says no San Francisco programs will be eliminated due to a sale.

item.title: Tahoe avalanche updates: Six moms, one from San Francisco, identified as victims
item.description: A spokesperson for several families named the victims as Carrie Atkin, Liz Clabaugh, Danielle Keatley, Kate Morse, Caroline Sekar, and Kate Vitt.

item.title: Oakland’s Alysa Liu wins gold, and everyone wants in on the celebration
item.description: From Gov. Gavin Newsom to BART, all eyes are on the U.S. figure skater.

item.title: Plan to prioritize locals could transform SF homelessness strategy
item.description: A proposal would give locals an edge in landing housing. But Trump’s DEI crackdown may stand in the way.

item.title: Kawakami: Joe Lacob on Porzingis, trading Kuminga, and why the Warriors won’t tank
item.description: The Golden State owner also addressed trade deadline speculation involving Draymond Green and Steve Kerr’s future with the team.

item.title: Even in a loss, Kristaps Porzingis shows glimpses of why the Warriors coveted him
item.description: Considered a “matchup problem” by his new teammates, the 7-foot-2 center can transform the way Golden State plays.

item.title: PST: AI writes the code now; The Castro Theatre’s glow-up
item.description: We explain why the tech world is in a frenzy over AI’s capabilities, plus take listeners inside the new-and-improved Castro Theatre.

item.title: Tony Vitello’s first chance to turn Giants skeptics into believers comes this Saturday
item.description: How the former college coach handles critical decisions during Cactus League play will shape the way fans perceive his capabilities.

item.title: Democrats need to stop aura farming and start fixing our broken education funding
item.description: A San Francisco school board and DCCC member questions the motives of politicians who showed solidarity for teachers without offering real budget solutions.

item.title: ‘Section 415’ podcast: Who are the Giants’ early standouts at spring training?
item.description: The Standard’s John Shea analyzes Rafael Devers, Luis Arráez, Harrison Bader, and other key players who hope to spark a turnaround.
